content.description:
Yahoo Finance host Madison Mills catches investors up on this morning's top trending stocks in this Market Minute, including shares of quantum computing developers IonQ (IONQ), D-Wave Quantum (QBTS), and Rigetti Computing (RGTI) ahead of a panel event at Nvidia's 2025 GTC (NVDA); Affirm's (AFRM) stock reaction to Klarna replacing it as Walmart's (WMT) "buy now, pay later" provider; and Netflix's (NFLX) latest upgrade from the team out of MoffettNathanson.
